title: receipt
description: Phone → watch. The observations the phone has taken responsibility for. A receipt is the acknowledgement that lets the watch drop an observation it sent, and it is deliberately not tied to a session: a nutrition quick-log taken with no workout running names a session the phone does not hold, so `session_snapshot` — the other way the watch learns an entry arrived — can never carry it back. Applying a receipt confirms the ids it names and changes nothing else.

entryIds.description: The `entryId`s the phone now holds. A receipt asserts that the phone has the observation, not that it changed anything: an id whose food the phone's library no longer carries is still acknowledged, because a row nothing can resolve is not a row worth the watch re-sending forever. An id the watch does not hold is not an error either — it is news about another client's log.
